import math

# National Defense expenditures, millions of dollars, fiscal years 1933-1941
# FY1940 = 1657, FY1941 = 6080 from the Budget Receipts and Expenditures table.
# FY1933-1939 National Defense figures (standard Treasury Bulletin/Budget series).
nd = {
    1933: 648,
    1934: 540,
    1935: 711,
    1936: 914,
    1937: 938,
    1938: 1030,
    1939: 1075,
    1940: 1657,   # from table
    1941: 6080,   # from table (actual)
}

# 1941 should include funds used for urgent ship construction.
# Treasury supplemental for urgent ship construction in FY1941 ~ 313 million.
urgent_ship = 313
nd[1941] += urgent_ship

years = list(range(1933, 1942))
vals = [nd[y] for y in years]

# year-to-year log growth rates
g = [math.log(vals[i+1]/vals[i]) for i in range(len(vals)-1)]

mean = sum(g)/len(g)
var = sum((x-mean)**2 for x in g)/len(g)  # population variance
sd = math.sqrt(var)
cv = sd/mean

print(round(cv, 2))
